title: Good Survival Modpack
description: Adds a bunch of visual mods with some technical to enhance yout survival playthrough!
body:
You’re still playing Minecraft the way you know it mining, crafting, building, exploring.

But now, the world feels so much more alive.

Trees sway gently in the wind, shadows shift as the sun moves, and light filters through leaves at just the right angle.

The blocky charm is still there, but it’s enhanced with smoother animations, richer colors, and more atmosphere.

It’s like stepping into a more cinematic version of the game everything looks and feels deeper, more immersive.

Every moment, from building your first shelter to exploring deep caves, feels more meaningful just because of how the world looks and moves.

It’s not just a visual upgrade it’s a whole new vibe.


If you want the same shader that you can see in the pictures from the end go to 
https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/shaders/iterationt-3-2-0
